newsitem.title: USA: Gulf South agrees to acquire Gateway.
newsitem.headline: Gulf South agrees to acquire Gateway.

text.p: Gulf South Medical Supply Inc said it had signed an agreement to acquire Gateway Healthcare Corp for about $38.8 million in cash and warrants to purchase 450,000 of its shares.

Based in Richmond, Virginia, Gateway Healthcare distributes medical supplies and related products to long-term care facilities and office-based physicians. It had sales of some $67 million for the past 12-month period.
Gulf South Medical Supply Inc is a national distributor of medical supplies and related products to the long-term care industry.
